master_headline: MILAN PLOT ENDRICK MOVE AS MOURINHO RESISTS EXIT
ticker_text: CORRIERE DELLO SPORT: MILAN PREPARE €60M PROPOSAL FOR ENDRICK ✦ CADENA SER: MOURINHO RESISTS EXIT ✦ REAL MADRID: ADDUCTOR INJURY CONFIRMED ✦

scenes.spoken_narration: Milan have made their move, but Mourinho wants him to stay.
And — Italian reports put Milan's package for Endrick at sixty million fixed, plus ten in potential bonuses.
Now — reports cite eighty to eighty-five million repurchase figures, but crucially... nothing is agreed.
Meanwhile — a left-leg muscle injury complicates matters, with no official return date.
So — will Mourinho keep the Brazilian, or will Milan force a compromise?
Either way — this is football in thirty seconds. Follow for daily transfer updates.
